name: ci-cadence-churn-refinement
title: Refine CI cadence: cancelled-lane transient FAILURE and redundant queued main runs
description: Two rough edges surfaced by PR #179's auto-merge full-gate + per-commit main concurrency, observed on PR #186 (first PR under the new rules): (1) arming auto-merge triggers a full run that cancels the in-progress lane, and the aggregate 'test' job's if:always() reports FAILURE for the cancelled lane before the rerun's 'test' reports SUCCESS — a transient red check with a latent auto-merge-stall risk if the FAILURE run is ever the latest for the required context; (2) per-commit main concurrency leaves superseded commits' backstop runs queued (observed 4e1c182 queued after 49bd1b9 merged). Both are documented #179 trade-offs but rougher than ideal.
creator: sdelmas
